title: Steam a Kueh Tutu
blurb: Six steps from rice grain to pandan leaf.
fact: Kueh tutu is said to have been created in Singapore in the 1930s by Mr Tan Eng Huat. Its flower shape is believed to come from the chrysanthemum.
credit: Source: Kueh Tutu (ICH-068), Intangible Cultural Heritage inventory, Roots.sg, National Heritage Board. Text and art are original.

items.label: Pound and sift rice grains into light flour
Fill the flower-shaped mould with rice flour
Scoop out a gap in the middle
Add ground peanuts or shredded coconut
Cover with more flour and a muslin cloth, then steam
Serve on a square of pandan leaf
